```plato
    // Every edge shorter than `minLength` collapsed to its midpoint, except those
    // that would cross the boundary. Only an independent set of them survives the
    // conflict rule, so short edges left over are collapsed by a later pass.
    CollapseShortEdges(self: TriangleMesh3D, minLength: Number): TriangleMesh3D
    {
        var topology = self.TopologyOf;
        var boundary = self.BoundaryVertexFlags(topology);
        return self.CollapseEdges(topology, topology.EdgeCount.MapRange(e =>
            (self.EdgeLength(topology, UndirectedEdgeIndex(e)) < minLength)
                .And(CrossesBoundary(boundary, topology.UndirectedEdges[e]).Not)),
            e => self.EdgeMidpoint(topology, UndirectedEdgeIndex(e)));
    }
```
